verdicts.reason: Both use the same layout. In both, the green circle now sits behind the can and crowds it, and the subhead sits too close to the CTA button. A breaks the headline so that 'fizz' is left alone on the second line, but its text block reads as one evenly spaced group. B keeps the headline on one line but runs it almost to the canvas edges, and spacing is uneven: there is a large gap between the headline and the subhead, then cramped spacing between the subhead and the CTA, which weakens the grouping.
